note: Contract 0x1315 routes WETH through USDT to buy 43133.53 DON on the USDT/DON pool 0x91b1. The victim then buys DON with USDT on that same pool, and 0x1315 sells exactly the same DON back, ending with +0.131181 WETH. I treated the 0.107501 ETH paid to the sending EOA as internal to the actor but counted the 0.103798 ETH paid to 0x5a0b (likely a builder or miner payment) as a cost, giving 0.027383 ETH, or about +0.003375 ETH after 0.024008 ETH of gas; the margin is thin and depends on that treatment.
